headline: Focused Growth, Margin Expansion

highlights: Revenue stood at INR 8.2 Bn, Growing 34.7% QoQ and 38.1% YoY (6.2% above our estimates).
Gross margin expanded to 29.3%, compared with 33.9% in Q1FY27 and 28.26% in Q2FY26 (vs. our estimate of 28.5%).
EBITDA came in at INR 1,005 Mn, up 30.3% QoQ and 82.4% YoY (8.3% above our estimates).
EBITDA margin stood at 12.24%, compared with 12.7% in Q1FY27 and 9.27% in Q2FY26 (vs. our estimate of 12%).
valuation: We maintain our BUY rating and revise our target price to INR 415.

CapEx, Working Capital & Other Updates • Working capital efficiency has improved through tighter credit controls, with receivable days targeted at 35-40 days and inventory days at 70-80 days. • Installed manufacturing capacity currently stands at approximately 435,000 MTPA, with focus on improving utilisation before major expansion. • FY27 CapEx is estimated at INR 2 Bn, while FY28 CapEx is expected at INR 1-1.2 Bn.
watch: Outlook: Prince Pipes is well-positioned to sustain healthy growth, supported by market share gains, distribution expansion and increasing contribution from value-added products.
Analyst Outlook Prince Pipes is expected to sustain healthy volume growth, supported by improving channel restocking, distribution expansion and market share gains amid industry consolidation.
